test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

In order to protect his identity, the spy had to **__efface__** all evidence of his true name and occupation from his personal documents.
solution:
The correct answer is** "destroy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Efface"** means to make something disappear; to remove something. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) विलुप्‍त कर देना; मिटा देना या हटा देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The whole country had tried to **efface**__ the memory of the old dictatorship.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the spy had to remove all traces of his true identity from his personal documents.
 
• **"Destroy" **is the most appropriate synonym for** "efface"** in this context.
 
• **"Destroy" **means to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The building was **destroyed**__ by fire.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "reveal",** means to make something known or visible. ((गुप्‍त या पूर्वतः अज्ञात वस्‍तु को) प्रकट करना, रहस्‍य खोल लेना)
 
• **Option 2, "clarify", **means to make something clear or understandable. (किसी प्रसंग को स्‍पष्‍ट और सुबोध बनाना; स्‍पष्‍टीकरण करना)
 
• **Option 3, "maintain", **means to keep something in a certain condition or state. (किसी वस्‍तु को उसी स्‍तर, मानक आदि पर बनाए रखना, जारी रखना)
